answer: Seed each new agent with a verifiable delay function keyed to the latest ledger beacon: a sequential squaring chain no GPU can parallelize. One honest node crosses the meadow in an hour; a sybil swarm must each burn that same wall-clock, like a comet that cannot be in two skies at once. An identity hardens into onyx only after its delay proof verifies, so minting a thousand fakes costs a thousand serial hours, not a cheap fork.
